metadata.title: Master Task Index — Advanced Quality Tool
metadata.purpose: Top-level index for the advanced-quality-tool only. Work is split into per-phase task files, with bugs and change requests tracked separately under maintenance/.
metadata.sourceOfTruth: Per-phase task files in this folder. The legacy monolithic TASKS.json (in the tool root) mirrors the same tasks and should be treated as read-only history.
metadata.notes: When adding/renaming a planned task: place it in the correct phaseN-tasks.json, then update the matching module entry below and the rollup. For bugs and change requests (CRs/tweaks), inspect maintenanceFiles below, identify the exact related phase task, and record its task ID and phase file. meta.json holds scoring/roadmap/research metadata and is not a task list.

workflow: Before recording a bug or CR/tweak, find the exact task in the phase task files. If no matching task exists, add the planned task to the appropriate phase file first.
Every record must include phaseTaskId and phaseTaskFile pointing to that exact task; do not guess or leave the link unresolved.
Append bug records to bugs-tasks.json and CR/tweak records to cr-tasks.json. Each shard holds at most 100 records.

When the current shard reaches 100 records, create the next numbered shard (for example, bugs-tasks-002.json or cr-tasks-002.json) and add its relative path to the matching index (bugs.json or crs.json). Keep each index's shard counts and ID boundaries current.

modules.name: Core Foundation & Auto-Fix Engine
modules.reconciliationNote: Phase 1 complete. P1-T016 resolved by fixing the 11 failing unit-test assertions at their source (AutoFixEngine, FileWatcher.matchPattern, BuildMonitor). P1-T017 added test/__tests__/integration.test.js (5 offline end-to-end cases) and, along the way, fixed a real cross-platform createBackup bug (absolute-path join) via stripPathRoot(). Added test/__tests__/extension.test.js (22 tests). Full suite: 112 passing / 0 failing. P3-T008 packaging is config + documented layouts; marketplace publish left as an operator step (needs publisher token).

modules.name: Level 2 Supervised Autonomous Code-Generation Agent
modules.reconciliationNote: Planned work to connect real model execution, workspace tools, validated patching, approval gates, real verification, bounded repair, persistence, and end-to-end evidence for supervised Level 2 autonomy. P12-T001 was corrected from PENDING to COMPLETED (tracking error; work was already done). P12-T002 (model-backed step execution) and P12-T003 (ToolRegistry wired into execution with budgets, allowlisted run_check, hash-guarded edit_file, and real get_diagnostics) are completed and tested. P12-T004 (bounded, hashed workspace context wired into task execution) and P12-T005 (structured, context-grounded versioned plans with deterministic scope/dependency/budget validation and exact-plan approval) are completed and tested. P12-T007 (PermissionManager-enforced plan and per-tool policies, digest-bound approvals, cancellation/denial/timeout fail-closed behavior, and auditable decisions) is completed and focused tests pass. P12-T006 now provides structured model-generated workspace patches through DiffReviewSystem, with path/hash/stale-content checks, changed-file limits, review diffs, PermissionManager policy enforcement, and plan/patch-digest-bound approval; isolated patch tests and adjacent regressions pass. P12-T008 and later tasks remain unchanged and unstarted.

contextCompressionStrategy.description: Techniques to keep context lean through this long multi-phase implementation.

strategies.name: Rolling Summary Pattern
strategies.detail: After completing each phase (or logical group of tasks), write a compact PROGRESS_SUMMARY.md in the tasks folder with a one-liner per completed task (id + artifact path + status). Future turns reference that file instead of re-reading all phase files.

strategies.name: Session Notes File
strategies.detail: Maintain active-session-notes.md with: current active task ID, files modified this session, key decisions made. This survives context compaction.

strategies.name: Shallow Phase Reads
strategies.detail: For completed phases (1–3, 5, 6), read only their completedIds from master_tasks_index.json rather than full phase files. Only deep-read the phase currently being actively worked on.

strategies.name: Artifact-First Verification
strategies.detail: Instead of re-reading all related source files when starting a new task, check whether the artifact path listed in the task exists and is non-empty. If yes, mark it complete without full re-read unless the new task depends on its internals.

strategies.name: Task Completion Timestamps In Place
strategies.detail: As tasks are completed, immediately update the task JSON status and log in master_tasks_index.json so future sessions can skip reconciliation.

rollup.note: Computed from task records in all phase files. Phase 12 delivers supervised Level 2 autonomy; Phase 13 extends it to policy-bounded Level 3. Archived tasks are included in totalTasks but excluded from the completion percentage denominator.
